meta.title: Synthetic test case: rice-water stools since dawn, now cannot stand, pulse thready

presentation.chief_complaint: Watery stools twenty times since dawn, vomiting, now too weak to stand.
presentation.hpi: Synthetic history for a test. Nothing here is a real person.

symptom_script.patient_words: Like rice water, no pain, twenty times since dawn.

finding.display: Others in the household with the same illness

symptom_script.patient_words: My brother started yesterday. We drink from the same well.

exam_findings.value: Sunken eyes, skin pinch goes back very slowly, cold hands, capillary refill 4 seconds, drowsy but rousable (GCS 14)

order.display: Stool rapid test for Vibrio cholerae

correct_diagnosis.display: Cholera with severe dehydration and hypovolaemic shock

expected_workup.display: Stool rapid test for Vibrio cholerae

red_flags: Cannot drink, skin pinch very slow, pulse thready, pressure 78 = severe dehydration with shock — intravenous rehydration must start within minutes
Do not give antimotility drugs (loperamide) in cholera
management_plan: Rapid intravenous rehydration with Ringer's lactate: 30 mL/kg as fast as possible (within 30 minutes), reassess the pulse and the skin pinch
Then the second phase: 70 mL/kg over the next 2.5 hours, and replace ongoing stool losses volume for volume
Correct the potassium: add potassium chloride to the fluid once urine is passed; check electrolytes and glucose
Oral rehydration solution as soon as the patient can drink, alongside the drip
Single-dose doxycycline 300 mg once vomiting settles, to shorten the diarrhoea and shedding
No antimotility drugs; no antiemetic beyond what stops the ORS being vomited
Notify the case; chlorinate the household's water; treat household contacts who are ill
Explain that the drip replaces what the stools take out and that the drinking must continue at home
